To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mechanical milling of Ti6AlV4 powders for 90h in alcohol media is the best condition, the particle size is about 50 nm, and the grain size is about 30 nm.
Ti6Al4 V prealloyed powder with the particle size of about 50 nm can be obtained by ball milling for 90 h.
The prealloyed Ti6Al4 V powders were prepared using mechanical milling method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of nano-sized Ti6Al4 V powders by mechanical alloying in alcohol media.
the preparation of Ti6AlV4 prealloyed powder and the investigation of its microstructure.
the preparation of nano-sized Ti6Al4 V prealloyed powder by mechanical milling in ethanol.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mechanical alloying process is very efficient for the synthesis of Ti6Al 4V alloy.
the mechanical milling is an efficient method to prepare Ti6Al4v prealloyed powder.
the mechanical milling is a very effective way to refine the powders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the prealloying process of titanium alloy powder is feasible by mechanical milling in the alcohol media.
the prealloying process is an effective means to prepare Ti6Al4 V nano-powders.

Ti6Al4v alloy powders with nano-meter particle size were prepared by ball milling in alcohol media,which could be used as raw material for preparation of Ti6Al 4V alloy parts with nano-meter microstructure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Ti6Al4 V alloy is a very promising candidate for the production of nanostructured powder.
the Ti6Al4v alloy is a very good material for use in the aerospace industry.
the mechanical milling of Ti6AlV4 powders can achieve nano-meter size,which is very important to the sintering process of Ti alloy parts.
